subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline image rendering be allowed to read absolute host-local MEDIA paths from tool output, or must it render only trusted media-store/structured attachment references?
rationale: The implementation reads local image files in the TUI process based on model/tool output; that boundary is product and security policy, not a mechanical code-style choice.

options.title: Require trusted media references
options.body: Render only media-store or structured attachment references and reject arbitrary host-local paths from tool output before merge.

options.title: Allow guarded host-local image reads
options.body: Accept the local-read behavior with documented constraints, tests, and live proof showing fallback behavior on unsupported terminals.

options.title: Defer to canonical issue
options.body: Keep this draft paused or close it later and let the open canonical feature issue decide the rendering boundary first.

recommendation.title: Require trusted media references
recommendation.body: Render only media-store or structured attachment references and reject arbitrary host-local paths from tool output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the current TUI rendering path history and the adjacent image_generate feature provenance.
